attributes.description: Estate-wide health for Google Cloud Storage. Answers: is anything failing, is it our fault or Google's, and which bucket is affected — without clicking. Scoped to resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" only; this data stream is shared with other GCP services.

embeddableConfig.description: Estate-wide health for Google Cloud Storage: whether anything is failing, whether it is the caller's fault or Google's, which buckets are worst, and where the storage bill is going. Click a bucket anywhere on this dashboard to drill into it.

attributes.description: Navigation tile — opens the Kibana dashboards list filtered to the other GCP dashboards in a new tab, carrying the current time range.

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens the Kibana dashboards list filtered to the other GCP dashboards in a new tab, carrying the current time range.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Availability %` = TO_DOUBLE(`OK Requests`) / `Total Requests` * 100
| KEEP `Availability %`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE response_code == "OK", `Total Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))
| EVAL `Availability %` = TO_DOUBLE(`OK Requests`) / `Total Requests` * 100
| KEEP `Availability %`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of all GCS API requests across the estate that returned OK in the selected range, from storage.googleapis.com/api/request_count. Every bucket and method counts equally, so the busiest buckets dominate this number — use the bucket health table to see which buckets are actually failing.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS request availability

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED")
| STATS `Total GCS Client-Fault Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND (attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED")) | STATS `Total GCS Client-Fault Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY TBUCKET(75)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED")
| STATS `Total GCS Client-Fault Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`))

embeddableConfig.description: Requests that failed for a caller-side reason — NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, UNAUTHENTICATED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FAILED_PRECONDITION or CANCELLED — summed over the range, with a sparkline of the same series. These are usually application bugs, stale object paths or missing IAM bindings rather than a GCS problem.
embeddableConfig.title: Total GCS client-fault request count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE `resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type` == "gcs_bucket" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `Total GCS Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`storage.googleapis.com/network/sent_bytes_count`))

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE `resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type` == "gcs_bucket" AND TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS `Total GCS Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(`storage.googleapis.com/network/sent_bytes_count`))

embeddableConfig.description: Bytes sent from GCS buckets to clients in the selected range (storage.googleapis.com/network/sent_bytes_count). This is the volume egress pricing is charged on; it does not include cross-region replication traffic.
embeddableConfig.title: Total GCS egress bytes

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL `Fault Class` = CASE(
    attributes.response_code == "OK", "OK",
    attributes.response_code IN ("UNAVAILABLE", "INTERNAL", "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED", "ABORTED", "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"), "service-fault",
    attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), "client-fault",
    "other"
  )
| STATS `API Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Fault Class`, `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.response_code IS NOT NULL
| EVAL `Fault Class` = CASE(
    attributes.response_code == "OK", "OK",
    attributes.response_code IN ("UNAVAILABLE", "INTERNAL", "DEADLINE_EXCEEDED", "ABORTED", "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED"), "service-fault",
    attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), "client-fault",
    "other"
  )
| STATS `API Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY `Fault Class`, `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Request volume split into OK, client-fault (caller-side errors) and service-fault (Google-side errors such as UNAVAILABLE or INTERNAL), so you can tell whose problem a spike is. A growing red band points at GCS itself; a growing amber band points at the callers.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS API request count over time by fault class

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS numerator = SUM(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject", denominator = SUM(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) WHERE attributes.method == "ReadObject" BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `GCS Read Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(numerator) / TO_DOUBLE(denominator)
| KEEP bucket, `GCS Read Availability`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS numerator = SUM(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK" AND attributes.method == "ReadObject", denominator = SUM(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) WHERE attributes.method == "ReadObject" BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `GCS Read Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(numerator) / TO_DOUBLE(denominator)
| KEEP bucket, `GCS Read Availability`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of ReadObject requests that returned OK per time bucket, across all buckets — the read-path SLI. Buckets with very little read traffic can swing this line sharply, so read it together with request volume.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS read availability over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "WriteObject"
| STATS `Write OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Write Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `GCS write availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`Write OK Requests`) / `Total Write Requests`
| KEEP bucket, `GCS write availability`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.method == "WriteObject"
| STATS `Write OK Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Total Write Requests` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `GCS write availability` = TO_DOUBLE(`Write OK Requests`) / `Total Write Requests`
| KEEP bucket, `GCS write availability`

embeddableConfig.description: Share of WriteObject requests that returned OK per time bucket, across all buckets — the write-path SLI. Writes fail for different reasons than reads (quota, preconditions, object holds), so watch this separately from read availability.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS write availability over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) BY `Method` = attributes.method
| SORT `Request Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Request Count` = SUM(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`) BY `Method` = attributes.method
| SORT `Request Count` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: The ten most-called GCS API methods in the selected range. Useful for spotting an unexpected access pattern, such as a job repeatedly listing a bucket instead of reading objects directly — list operations are billed at the higher Class A rate.
embeddableConfig.title: Top 10 GCS methods by request count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Ingress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/received_bytes_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)), `Ingress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/received_bytes_count`)) BY `Time` = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Bytes leaving GCS (sent to clients) and entering it (received from clients) over time. Egress drives network cost and is usually the larger of the two; a sudden ingress climb means something started uploading at an unusual rate.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS egress and ingress bytes over time

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)), `Client-Fault Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), `OK Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)) BY `Bucket Name` = resource.attributes.bucket_name, `Location` = resource.attributes.location
| WHERE `Total Request Count` >= 50
| EVAL `Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(`OK Request Count`, 0)) / `Total Request Count`
| DROP `OK Request Count`
| SORT `Availability` ASC
| LIMIT 100

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)), `Client-Fault Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code IN ("NOT_FOUND", "PERMISSION_DENIED", "UNAUTHENTICATED", "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "FAILED_PRECONDITION", "CANCELLED"), `OK Request Count` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/api/request_count`)) WHERE attributes.response_code == "OK", `Egress Bytes` = SUM(SUM_OVER_TIME(storage.googleapis.`com/network/sent_bytes_count`)) BY `Bucket Name` = resource.attributes.bucket_name, `Location` = resource.attributes.location
| WHERE `Total Request Count` >= 50
| EVAL `Availability` = TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(`OK Request Count`, 0)) / `Total Request Count`
| DROP `OK Request Count`
| SORT `Availability` ASC
| LIMIT 100

embeddableConfig.description:
Buckets ranked by lowest availability, filtered to those with 50+ requests.

Availability = successful requests ÷ total requests. Buckets below the 50-request threshold are excluded to avoid noise — see the hexagon map above for full coverage.
Click any bucket name to open its detail dashboard.

drilldowns.label: 3. View bucket in Google Cloud console

embeddableConfig.title: GCS bucket health — buckets with 50+ requests

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total GCS Storage` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total GCS Storage`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total GCS Storage` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total GCS Storage`

embeddableConfig.description: Total bytes stored across all buckets on the most recent day in range, from the storage/total_bytes gauge. GCP samples this roughly once a day, so it steps rather than curves and a short time window can return nothing at all.
embeddableConfig.title: Total GCS storage

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Object Count`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Object Count` = TO_INTEGER(SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/object_count`))) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day` DESC
| LIMIT 1
| KEEP `Total Object Count`

embeddableConfig.description: Number of objects across all buckets on the most recent day in range, from the storage/object_count gauge. Like stored bytes this is a once-a-day sample and needs a multi-day window to be meaningful.
embeddableConfig.title: Total object count

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Bucket Name` = resource.attributes.bucket_name, `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Total Stored Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.storage.googleapis.`com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Bucket Name` = resource.attributes.bucket_name, `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Total Stored Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: The ten largest buckets by stored bytes on the latest daily sample, broken down by storage class so you can see whether the big ones sit in Standard (hot, most expensive) or in Nearline, Coldline and Archive. Click a bar to drill into that bucket.
embeddableConfig.title: Top GCS buckets by storage — click to drill down

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Storage Class` = attributes.storage_class
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: How the estate's stored bytes are distributed across storage classes on the latest daily sample. A large Standard share on data nobody reads is the most common source of avoidable GCS spend.
embeddableConfig.title: Storage breakdown by class

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Stored Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_bytes`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day`

embeddableConfig.description: Estate-wide stored bytes per day. Because GCP samples storage once a day this is a step function rather than a smooth curve — sustained upward steps mean real growth, while a flat line just means nothing was added or deleted.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS total stored bytes over time (estate-wide, daily)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Byte Seconds` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_byte_seconds`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket"
| STATS `Total Byte Seconds` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/total_byte_seconds`)) BY `Day` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 day)
| SORT `Day`

embeddableConfig.description: Byte-seconds per day: bytes stored multiplied by how long they were stored. This is the quantity GCS storage pricing is derived from, so it tracks cost more faithfully than a point-in-time byte count.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS total byte-seconds over time (daily)

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
    AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`)) BY `Object Type` = attributes.type
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
    AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Storage Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`)) BY `Object Type` = attributes.type
| SORT `Storage Bytes` DESC
| LIMIT 10

embeddableConfig.description: Non-live objects are billed but hidden in GCS v1
embeddableConfig.title: Storage by object type

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND attributes.type != "live-object"
    AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Non-Live Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

TS metrics-gcp.cloudstorage.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gcs_bucket" AND attributes.type IS NOT NULL AND attributes.type != "live-object"
    AND `metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes` IS NOT NULL
| STATS `Non-Live Bytes` = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.storage.googleapis.com/storage/v2/total_bytes`))
    BY `Object Type` = attributes.type, `Time` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time`

embeddableConfig.description: Noncurrent, soft-deleted and multipart-upload bytes over time, with live objects excluded. Growth here without a matching drop elsewhere means retention or lifecycle policy is accumulating billable data nobody reads.
embeddableConfig.title: GCS non-live storage over time by object type — reclaimable capacity

embeddableConfig.description: One hexagon per GCS bucket, coloured by the share of API requests that returned a non-OK response over the selected window. Buckets are ordered worst-first. A bucket is only coloured once it has at least 50 requests in the window: below that a single NOT_FOUND from a scanner reads as 100% errors, so low-traffic buckets stay grey. Hover for a sparkline of the error rate. Click to open the bucket detail dashboard or Discover.
